mapper.update: UPDATE virtual_inventory_quota SET state = IF(surplus_qty >= 0 AND surplus_qty = #{quantity} AND state = 'open', 'exhausted', state), issued_qty = issued_qty + #{quantity}, surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty - #{quantity}), update_time = NOW() WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND (surplus_qty < 0 OR surplus_qty >= #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, inv_id, name, type, value, surplus_qty, issued_qty, state, create_time, update_time FROM virtual_inventory_quota WHERE state = 'open'
SELECT value FROM virtual_inventory_quota WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND type = 'POINTS'
SELECT inv_id AS invId, type, value, surplus_qty AS surplusQty, issued_qty AS issuedQty FROM virtual_inventory_quota WHERE inv_id IN #{invId}
SELECT inv_id AS invId, value FROM virtual_inventory_quota WHERE type = 'POINTS' AND inv_id IN #{invId}
